label: Technical Debt Assessment
description: Identifies, categorizes, and prioritizes technical debt from code descriptions, architecture notes, or incident patterns. Produces debt register with business impact and remediation recommendations.

guidedInputs.label: System or codebase name
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Customer API, Legacy Billing System, Monolith, Data Warehouse

guidedInputs.label: Technology stack
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Node.js 14 / Express / MongoDB 4.4 / hosted on EC2

guidedInputs.label: Engineering team size working on this system
Known technical debt and pain points
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe what you know. Include:
- Areas of code that are hard to change
- Frequent sources of bugs or incidents
- Things developers complain about
- Outdated technologies or patterns
- Missing tests, documentation, or monitoring
- Architecture decisions that no longer fit
- Performance bottlenecks you live with

No format required — stream of consciousness is fine.

guidedInputs.label: Recent incidents or recurring issues
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., We have a monthly incident where the order processor gets stuck and requires manual restart. Memory usage climbs steadily after every deployment.

guidedInputs.label: Business context and constraints
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., We need to scale from 1k to 10k concurrent users by Q3. The system processes EUR 5M/day in transactions. We have 2 engineers available for debt work, budget is EUR 150k.
